seoTitle: Hreflang x-default Advisor and Tag Generator
metaDescription: Choose the right x-default for a language selector, a global page or a redirecting home page, and get the complete tag set.
intro: Explains which page should be your x-default for your setup and generates the tag set with it added.
why:
x-default names the page for visitors whose language matches none of your versions. Google says it was designed for language selector pages, and also works as a general fallback. The right target depends on your setup, and the tool explains each case: a selector page, a global page, a home page that redirects by browser language, or no fallback at all.

The generated set includes x-default and a reminder that every version, including the x-default page, must carry the complete set.
howTo: Enter your versions as code | URL lines.
Choose your setup and optionally enter the x-default URL.
Copy the tags into every version.

faq.q: Can x-default be the same URL as a language?
faq.a: Yes, a version can carry both codes.
Keep plain links to every version; Google does not vary its crawler by location.

faq.q: Does it need a language code?
faq.a: No, the x-default page is for unmatched users, so its language is irrelevant.
